name: Old-RT
description: The old Railway Theatre based in Swindon, UK. Where they show classic movies accompanied by themed snacks. The site is built using HTML and CSS. The site is hosted on Github pages.

paragraphs: The website is designed to show any potential customer what 'The Old Railway Theatre' does and what special items it has that makes it different from other cinemas.
The users can easily find the movies that are planned in the coming days and by signing up can obtain a a telephone number to book tickets.
features: The website has a simple three page format - home, upcoming and sign-up pages.
The site also has the following features;
Navigation bar is visible on each page and highlights the page the user is currently on by increase the font size of the page name and by including both a bottom and top border around the page name.
The navigation bar sits in the top right of the page opposite the sites title.
On smaller screens the navigation bar sits below the site title.

whatItDoes.text: The website is designed to show any potential customer what 'The Old Railway Theatre' does and what special items it has that makes it different from other cinemas.

requirements.text: The site will also need to be upgraded to allow for tickets to be booked online, this will mean the site will need to give the user the ability to log in so they can access the benefits that the members are entitled to.
